Package arztis.econnector.ihe.utilities

Class ConfigReader

java.lang.Object
arztis.econnector.ihe.utilities.ConfigReader
public class ConfigReader extends Object
Singleton which contains all basic configuration like
  • service endpoints
  • GINA address
  • Server port
  • Enabling and disabling ELGA reference client functionalities
.
